domain: Rational number arithmetic (fraction and mixed-number subtraction)

skills.name: Convert to improper form
skills.definition: Convert mixed numbers and/or whole numbers into equivalent improper fractions (or fractions with a specified denominator) to enable computation.
inclusion_criteria: A step rewrites a mixed number a b/c as (a·c+b)/c
A step rewrites a whole number n as an equivalent fraction n = (n·d)/d to match a needed denominator
A step converts a nonstandard mixed form (e.g., 1 4/3) into an improper fraction
exclusion_criteria: A step only finds a common denominator and scales fractions that are already in fractional form (no mixed/whole conversion)
A step performs the subtraction once forms are already compatible
A step only reduces/simplifies or converts the final answer after subtraction

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine a common denominator (often via LCM) and rewrite each fraction as an equivalent fraction over that denominator by scaling numerator and denominator.
inclusion_criteria: A step explicitly finds/uses an LCM or otherwise selects a common denominator for unlike denominators
A step scales numerator and denominator to create equivalent fractions with the chosen common denominator
exclusion_criteria: Denominators are already equal and the work proceeds directly to subtract numerators
A step only converts mixed/whole numbers to improper/fraction form without addressing unlike denominators
A step only simplifies/reduces the result after subtraction

skills.name: Subtract rational numbers
skills.definition: Compute the difference of two rational numbers once they are in compatible forms (typically same denominator or separated whole and fractional parts).
inclusion_criteria: A step performs subtraction of fractions with the same denominator by subtracting numerators (a/b − c/b = (a−c)/b)
A step subtracts mixed numbers by subtracting whole parts and fractional parts (or an equivalent decomposition)
A step recognizes identical quantities subtract to 0 or yields an integer result
exclusion_criteria: A step only rewrites numbers (conversion) or only finds a common denominator without executing the subtraction
A step only reduces/simplifies or reformats the result after subtraction

skills.name: Simplify and format result
skills.definition: Reduce the computed result to lowest terms and/or express it in an accepted final form such as an integer, improper fraction, mixed number, or 0.
inclusion_criteria: A step reduces a fraction to lowest terms by dividing numerator and denominator by a common factor
A step states/checks that a fraction is already in lowest terms
A step converts an improper fraction to a mixed number or identifies an integer/0 final value
exclusion_criteria: A step whose main purpose is conversion to improper form or finding a common denominator before subtraction
A step that performs the subtraction but does not simplify or re-express the final value
